notes: Sources 2 and 3 are the same page (nerc.itmo.ru and neerc.ifmo.ru addresses, identical files); the role should be scoreboard, not standings, since it has a per-problem grid with tries and times. The page gives no contest date or place. Several team names repeat or are unofficial-looking (e.g. QarDU (Triada) appears twice); no sign of virtual participants. The crawl copy also holds the 2005 Uzbekistan page, which belongs to a different edition.
